mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals a deteriorating labor market, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary policy and fiscal stimulus that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 20th percentiles (10-year window), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the early pandemic shock regime, a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals severe economic disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105 and the regime is early pandemic shock, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1000) indicate weak residential construction activity, signaling a contracting economy and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to immediate economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level below 16500 billion (GDPC1 < 16500) signals a weak economic expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates policy interventions and recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 16500, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signal an economy in distress with ample room for monetary policy easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in aggressive stimulus.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing amid high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
